pass_rule: Every applicable expected external observation occurs
fail_rule: Any applicable required observation absent or contradictory
not_applicable_rule: Only when proposition genuinely outside declared configured/profile applicability
exception_handling: No waiver inside same claim; fix or narrow claim

pass_rule: If selected, declared profile observation occurs; if unselected remains diagnostic
fail_rule: Selected profile observation fails or applicability is silently inconsistent
not_applicable_rule: Permitted only when profile explicitly unselected
exception_handling: Record unresolved policy; never count unselected diagnostic as pass

pass_rule: Observed result lies within permitted set and suite does not demand one unspecified value
fail_rule: Implementation promises/depends on excluded value or produces result contradicting positive requirement
not_applicable_rule: When case cannot safely demonstrate variation, preserve non-assertion review
exception_handling: Prefer differential variants; absence of variation in one run is not proof of guarantee

pass_rule: Public required result passes without reliance on private/incidental mechanism
fail_rule: Acceptance criterion inspects or demands excluded mechanism
not_applicable_rule: May be review-only where no safe executable anti-test exists

pass_rule: Specified OS-level observations and image relations occur under pinned fixture
fail_rule: Unexpected result after narrow prerequisites pass
not_applicable_rule: Only for software/profile outside declared corpus
exception_handling: Classify fixture, product, permitted variation, profile mismatch or new investigation; never auto-create requirement
